newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb hits inland revenue office in Corsica.
newsitem.headline: Bomb hits inland revenue office in Corsica.

text.p: A bomb hit an inland revenue office in southern Corsica before dawn on Wednesday, causing much damage but no injuries, the paramilitary gendarmerie police said.
No one claimed responsibility for the attack at the town of Levie, carried out with an explosive device which was linked to a gas canister.
The town's accounts have been disputed by regional state auditors and some local taxpayers have set up an association to denounce what they say is the excessive debt burden imposed on them.
Earlier this week, bombings hit banks in other parts of the troubled Mediterranean island. Separatist guerrillas have been waging a long-running campaign for greater autonomy from France.
